status: frozen before any genuine stock-return evaluation; all present fixtures synthetic

candidate_rules.unchanged: momentum, positive trend and eligibility filters, monthly timing, 5 names, 2 per sector, 10% per name, 50% gross, whole shares
candidate_rules.retain: retain existing holdings still passing every filter and within the top 10 qualifying ranks, in rank order subject to sector/count caps; fill remaining slots by baseline rank
candidate_rules.limits: rank buffer does not prevent resizing trades, gap losses or excessive concentration within equity sleeve; not a claim of lower realized turnover or improved returns

data_gates: licensed point-in-time membership and permanent security identifiers including delisted securities
historical sector/security-type/exchange membership known at each decision
full exchange calendar and documented price availability/correction semantics
consolidated volume for the frozen 20-million-dollar liquidity threshold
raw prices reconciled to split/dividend total returns without double adjustment
ex-date entitlement, payable-date cash, delisting/merger recoveries, symbol changes and cash-in-lieu reconciled
settled cash, fees, fractional precision and shared execution policy audited
all omitted securities and halted/rejected sessions logged; no deletion of inconvenient histories
universe: PIT NYSE/NASDAQ/AMEX common stocks, permanent IDs; IPOs with fewer than 253 prior sessions ineligible as of decision, not silently removed from universe; unknown gaps fail study

periods.test_status: not acquired or evaluated here; independently attest prior project exposure before calling untouched
periods.insufficient_coverage: stop and register amended protocol before inspecting outcomes; do not choose new dates based on results
periods.prospective_reserve: 2027-01-01 to 2027-12-31 after approved pre-start version/data freeze; no collection activated

execution.decision: 08:00 America/New_York on first next exchange session after month end, using data available strictly before cutoff
execution.historical_fill: next regular-session open plus explicit costs; price-contingent whole-share sizing is a proxy, not a known pre-open MOO share order
execution.cost_status: frozen assumptions only; quotes if later available replace half-spread, not add a second spread
execution.cash_interest_sensitivity: dated investable cash-rate proxy with documented access; apply same convention to all strategies
execution.liquidity: <= 1% prior 20-session consolidated mean share volume per order; no filling halted or missing-open names
execution.gate: repair shared risk-cap/gap/settlement/precision rules before any full historical replay; an unresolved rejection invalidates study, not an omitted bad day

benchmarks: 50% same index plus 50% cash rebalanced monthly with consistent cash convention
unchanged baseline under identical execution/cost rules
primary_comparison: candidate minus baseline mean monthly net return; paired nonoverlapping calendar-year block bootstrap 10000 replicates seed 20261012, 95% interval; limitations from few blocks stated
secondary_metrics: Sharpe with dated risk-free rate or null if unavailable
gross bought and sold notional / pretrade NAV
one-way turnover = (buy + sell notional) / (2 * pretrade NAV)
decision_rule: single candidate proceeds from validation only if net return and turnover improve with no worse maximum drawdown; freeze before opening test. Economic improvement requires same directional gates on sealed test and lower endpoint of primary paired 95% interval >0. Otherwise retain baseline research status or conclude inconclusive; no retuning.
